project: Alpha Site — guía arquitectónica para simulación 3D
purpose: Definir una dirección arquitectónica coherente para imágenes de referencia y modelado 3D; no es documentación constructiva.
assumptions: Las coordenadas, huellas y número de niveles se toman de V08 como base conceptual, no como levantamiento verificado.
Las alturas, espesores, orientación de fachadas y detalles no presentes en V08 son parámetros visuales preliminares.
Las fachadas principales se orientan hacia accesos y rutas indicados por el masterplan; confirmar orientación y contexto al integrar el modelo.

campus_style.name: Sierra high-tech research campus
campus_style.design_intent: Campus de investigación de alta tecnología en un paisaje montañoso templado tipo Yosemite: arquitectura blanca, vidrio y metal de precisión, rodeada de pinos y bosque de coníferas. El ambiente debe sentirse fresco, alpino y científico, nunca tropical.
climate_response: Usar bosque de pinos, coníferas y especies templadas como contexto visual, con claros que mantengan legibles edificios y recorridos.
Diseñar fachadas herméticas de alto desempeño, marcos térmicos y vestíbulos protegidos apropiados para clima de montaña.
Cubiertas planas o de baja pendiente con drenaje y posible manejo de nieve, sin imponer condiciones topográficas no documentadas.
Mostrar luz fresca de montaña, aire limpio y vegetación de reserva; excluir palmeras, follaje tropical y atmósfera cálida húmeda.

palette.primary: crisp white and cool mineral white
palette.accent: restrained graphite and subtle ice blue

materials.roof: clean flat or low-slope high-performance roof with concealed technical systems

shared_rules: Use consistent white or graphite frames, crisp reveals, and restrained scientific wayfinding.
Make secure public entrances legible with a layered arrival sequence, canopy, vestibule, and glazed lobby.
Use generous clear glazing in public and collaboration areas with high-performance insulated glass; avoid mirror-like curtain walls.
Express research facilities as contemporary high-tech laboratories with precise modular facades and integrated mechanical systems.
Show realistic ground contact, parapets, service doors, and screened roof equipment in close views.
Use people, trees, and furniture only as scale/context cues; do not obscure building geometry.
Keep interior landscape clean and decorative: maintained lawn panels, crisp path edges, low ornamental planting, and sparse accent trees; avoid wild undergrowth or clutter.

perimeter_security.fence: continuous architectural graphite steel mesh or slim vertical-bar security fence following the site perimeter, with controlled vehicle and pedestrian openings only at the main gate
perimeter_security.main_gate: two clearly separated controlled vehicle lanes with barrier arms, access readers, visitor intercom, discreet bollards, and legible entry/exit arrows
perimeter_security.security_pavilion: modern high-tech glazed control booth at S01 footprint, with panoramic lane visibility, integrated access-control screens, cameras, and a clean white canopy
perimeter_security.parking_access: make R03 and R04 visibly connect the loop road to the parking aisle as separate entry and exit driveways; preserve their V08 locations

rendering.lighting: crisp high-altitude daylight, soft cool morning light or clear mountain overcast
rendering.visual_language: photorealistic architectural visualization, realistic material scale, clear silhouette, no text overlays
negative_guidance: no tropical plants or palm trees
no invented cliffs or terrain not shown in the conceptual site

Entry sides follow the conceptual pedestrian links in V08. Confirm final door locations, loading, emergency access, egress, fire strategy and service yards with the architectural plan.
Approximate heights and floor-to-floor dimensions are visualization parameters and require architectural validation.

Use a consistent camera, sun direction, white-and-glass palette, pine forest context, security fence and gate sequence, visible parking entry/exit, and clean decorative interior landscape when producing coordinated visuals.
